name: @neuropause/connectivity
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Wave 2 Enterprise Connectivity Platform. Composes the existing platform (runtime audit chain + event bus, security envelope-encryption vault, persistence SqlDriver, connector SDK/registry/executor/governance, integration transport/OAuth/reliability/sync/webhooks) into the NEMS connectivity layer: a tenant-aware connector lifecycle, an encrypted credential platform, a synchronization engine (retry queue + dead-letter queue + background workers), seven provider adapters (GitHub/Gmail/Calendar/Slack/Jira/Notion/PostgreSQL) built against a pluggable HTTP transport, unified enterprise search, a connector dashboard, and per-sync governance. Every sync is audited and published; every credential is encrypted at rest; every connector is tenant-aware. Adapters are verified against simulated provider responses through the transport seam; live provider execution requires operator-supplied OAuth credentials + network and is marked infra-pending, never fabricated. No AI copilot, knowledge-graph reasoning, automation, or ERP — those are later waves.
